children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Tuesday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0.1% lower at C$1.4046 to the greenback, or 71.19 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.4026 to 1.4049.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 2.7 basis points to 3.817%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt fell to 4.9449%.
futures fell $2.18 to $93.6 a barrel on Tuesday.
